title: ReviewCheckpointSaved.v1
description: Emitted when a batch of answers is committed as a checkpoint, capturing overall progress at that moment.

templateId.description: ID of the template whose questions were answered in this batch.
templateId.markdownDescription: ID of the template whose questions were answered in this batch.

note.description: Optional free-text note summarising the checkpoint session (may contain PII — subject to GDPR erasure).
note.markdownDescription: Optional free-text note summarising the checkpoint session (may contain PII — subject to GDPR erasure).

questionsAnswered.description: Number of questions that received an answer in this batch.
questionsAnswered.markdownDescription: Number of questions that received an answer in this batch.

questionsChanged.description: Number of previously-answered questions whose answer changed.
questionsChanged.markdownDescription: Number of previously-answered questions whose answer changed.

progressDelta.description: Percentage-point change in overall review progress after this checkpoint.
progressDelta.markdownDescription: Percentage-point change in overall review progress after this checkpoint.

overallProgress.description: Overall review completion percentage (0–100) after this checkpoint.
overallProgress.markdownDescription: Overall review completion percentage (0–100) after this checkpoint.

pillarSnapshots.description: Per-pillar progress snapshots captured at the time of the checkpoint.
pillarSnapshots.markdownDescription: Per-pillar progress snapshots captured at the time of the checkpoint.
